about_the_game:
【Game Rules】

This is a game about disguise. Players are split into two teams—Red and Blue—and must blend into groups of NPCs. To stay hidden, everyone has to act like the NPCs while trying to figure out who the enemy players are and take them out.

Weapons

  • Only one player per team starts with a gun. Everyone else carries an axe.

  • The player with the gun also receives two smoke grenades.

  • If the gunholder is eliminated, both the gun and smoke grenades will drop—and can be picked up by any player (friend or foe).

Revival

  • When a player is eliminated, they’re not out immediately—they enter a downed state.

  • Teammates can revive them by staying close for a short time.

Killing NPC

  • Killing an NPC will result in punishment: the player will be handcuffed and temporarily unable to attack.

How to Win

Red Team (Attackers):

  • Locate and eliminate a specific NPC to obtain the bomb, then plant and detonate it—all within the time limit.

  • Or eliminate all Blue Team players.

Blue Team (Defenders):

  • Prevent the Red Team from obtaining or planting the bomb.

  • Or eliminate all Red Team players before they plant the bomb.

  • If the bomb has been planted, defuse it before it explodes.
